model.$description: Colour standard for every Vivatheca model, print file and render (Luke, 2026-11-06). Change colours here, then run `pnpm tokens`.

tooth.$description: Realistic white teeth (wisdom tooth model v1.3 standard)

abscess.$description: Pus and inflamed tissue of an abscess or periapical lesion

dentineCut.$description: Cut face of a tooth in sectioned views

boneCut.$description: Cut face of bone in sectioned views

airflow.$description: Airflow arrows: air going the normal way

airLeak.$description: Airflow arrows: air escaping the wrong way (e.g. through the nose)

hardware.$description: Braces, implants, bridges, dentures, plates and screws

babyTeeth.$description: Development and orthodontic models only: baby teeth blue

adultTeeth.$description: Development and orthodontic models only: adult teeth yellow

muscle.$description: Muscle (masseter, temporalis, levator veli palatini sling): muscle red

muscleDeep.$description: Deep muscle (pterygoids): lighter muscle red so it reads apart from masseter and temporalis

disc.$description: Joint disc and cartilage (TMJ disc): light blue

printLabel.$description: Raised label on the base plate
